data.text: The LORD reigns; let the peoples tremble! He is enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth shake!
The LORD is great in Zion; he is exalted above all the peoples.
Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is holy!
The King’s strength loves justice. You have established equity; you have worked justice and righteousness in Jacob.
Exalt the LORD our God and bow down at his footstool. He is holy!
Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel among those who called on his name. They called to the LORD, and he answered them.
data.titulo: They Called, and the LORD Answered

data.text: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his testimonies and the statute he gave them.
LORD our God, you answered them; you were a forgiving God to them, though you punished them for their deeds.
Exalt the LORD our God and bow down at his holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
